circumstances: Well-known minerals businessman in Arusha, popularly known as "Banjoo". Abducted by unidentified people on 12 February 2026 as he was leaving a gym beneath the Ngorongoro building in Arusha. His body was found on 18 February 2026 beside the road in the Bereko area, Kondoa district, Dodoma region, bearing severe injuries: broken arms and gouged eyes.
